_comment: CONFIRMED against a live RP 5.15.x instance (POST /v1/{project}/filter -> UpdateUserFilterRQ: top-level 'conditions'/'orders', not 'entities'/'selectionParameters'). The 'name ne <sentinel>' condition is used as a permissive 'match everything' clause (RP rejects empty condition values), so this filter simply returns the most recent launches in start-time order.
name: Last 50 Launches
description: Most recent launches in this project, regardless of status. Used as the base filter for overview/trend widgets.
